name: Deepclock Tidal Core
description: A sealed pressure core humming with tidal timekeeping.
specialEffects: Used in abyssal relic chambers and pressure-bound chronal devices.

steps: Refine raw stock for Deepclock Tidal Core under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Deepclock Refinery protocol before storage.
